purpose: Expose species-origin environmental tolerance/adaptation capabilities as typed shared-record references so Environment resolution can test required capabilities without species-name branching or copied survival mechanics.
environment_owner_rule: Environment records declare factors, hazards and required capabilities/effects; they do not duplicate each species adaptation.

tolerance_grant_contract.rule: The referenced shared record owns thresholds, modifiers, immunity/resistance semantics and resolution behavior. Species only grants/references it.

unresolved_policy: If a required environmental mechanic has no canonical record, report the dependency/unresolved state; do not infer protection from descriptive biology.
